abilities.name: Fighting Alone
abilities.description: Once per round, when your partner Digimon gets attacked while there's no ally within 5 spaces of them, they can use a Free Action to hit back with a basic attack against whoever just attacked them. It has to be their basic attack, nothing from their signature move or their move pool.

abilities.name: Closer Alone
abilities.description: Fighting Alone's range tightens up. Instead of needing no ally within 5 spaces, it now only needs no ally within 3 spaces to trigger.

abilities.name: Strike on the Move
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon uses Fighting Alone, they can hit back with their signature move or something from their move pool instead of just their basic attack.

abilities.name: First to Move
abilities.description: At the start of each round, your partner Digimon can move up to 2 spaces by spending 4 Hope.

abilities.name: Never Left Standing
abilities.description: Fighting Alone stops being limited to once per round. Your partner Digimon can use it every single time they get attacked while no ally is nearby.

abilities.name: Wide Arc
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon makes a melee attack, they can hit up to 2 targets in range with that one attack instead of just one.
